title: Glucose–RDW coupling does not establish incremental HbA1c prediction across two NHANES surveys
abstract: Adding a fasting-glucose × RDW interaction to a flexible additive model did not establish improved HbA1c prediction transported from NHANES III (n=6,827) to 2017–2018 (n=2,371): weighted MSE 0.215458 to 0.215682, delta +0.000224, approximate joint PSU bootstrap95% [-0.001885,+0.003726] percentage-points squared. Source PSU cross-validation also worsened. Restricted and race-specific comparator estimates changed sign, emphasizing representation sensitivity rather than absence of erythrocyte biology. This exploratory analysis predicts measured HbA1c, not true glycemia, and is not untouched confirmation.
